newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat condemns Jerusalem blast, pledges to act.
newsitem.headline: Arafat condemns Jerusalem blast, pledges to act.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat condemned a double suicide bombing that killed 14 people in Jerusalem on Wednesday and said he would do all he could to confront anti-Israeli militants.

"I condemn completely this terrorist act because it is against the peace process, against the Palestinians, and against the Israelis," Arafat told Reuters. "We will do our (best) to face these terrorist activities as we have done in the past and will do in the future."
